user.title: Add Pico(s)
user.description: Select one or more Pico remotes to link as a single entry — pick several when they should all behave identically (e.g. multiple remotes for the same stairway light); their entities, timing, and behavior are configured once and shared. Only unconfigured Lutron Pico devices are listed, and all selected must be the same type — its type is detected automatically from the hardware, so there's nothing else to pick here.

entities.title: What do these Picos control?
entities.description: Fill in the entities for the ONE domain this entry's Pico(s) control, and leave the rest empty. If you selected more than one Pico, they all share this configuration.

buttons.title: Scene buttons
buttons.description: Assign one or more actions to each button. A button left empty does nothing when pressed. At least one button must be configured.

error.single_domain_required: Fill in exactly one of the fields above — the one domain this Pico controls — and leave the rest empty.
error.buttons_required: Configure at least one button with actions.
error.mixed_pico_types: Select devices of only one Pico type — the devices you picked aren't all the same type.

abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Lutron Pico remotes were found. Make sure the Lutron Caséta integration is set up and that the Pico isn't already configured.

devices.title: Edit Pico(s) in this entry
devices.description: Add or remove Picos from this entry. Only Picos of this entry's type ({pico_type}) that aren't claimed by another entry are offered; at least one must remain selected. The rest of this entry's configuration is shared by every Pico selected here.

entities.title: What do these Picos control?
entities.description: Fill in the entities for the ONE domain this entry's Pico(s) control, and leave the rest empty. If this entry has more than one Pico, they all share this configuration.

options.title: Options
options.description: Fine-tune timing and behavior. Applies to every Pico in this entry.

accent_light.title: Accent light
accent_light.description: Optional (P2B and 2B only): pick an accent light (e.g. a ring or edge light) to enable dual-light mode. ON switches to the Lights configured above; OFF switches to this accent light. The two are never on at the same time. Leave empty to disable dual-light mode.

accent_light_appearance.title: Accent light appearance (preset {preset_number})
accent_light_appearance.description: Choose what the accent light looks like for this preset. Effect and white-temperature choices are read from the first accent light selected; pick 'No effect' to use the color (or white temperature) instead. Check 'Add another preset' to configure a further appearance — repeated OFF taps while the accent light is already on cycle through every preset you add, in order.

hold_actions.title: STOP and hold actions
hold_actions.description: All optional. 'STOP actions' run on every STOP tap, replacing the default STOP behavior for this domain. The hold actions run in addition to the normal press behavior when ON, OFF, or STOP is held past the hold time — leave any of them empty to skip.

buttons.title: Scene buttons
buttons.description: Assign one or more actions to each button. A button left empty does nothing when pressed. At least one button must be configured.

error.single_domain_required: Fill in exactly one of the fields above — the one domain this Pico controls — and leave the rest empty.
error.buttons_required: Configure at least one button with actions.
error.at_least_one_device_required: Select at least one Pico to keep in this entry.

pico_type_mismatch.title: Pico hardware type mismatch
pico_type_mismatch.description: Device `{device_id}` is configured in Pico Link as a `{configured_type}`, but {reason}. Its button events are being ignored until this is resolved. Confirm the Pico's type in its Pico Link entry, or remove and re-add it if the physical device changed.

pico_removed.title: Pico removed from the Lutron bridge
pico_removed.description: "{title}" in Pico Link references device `{device_id}`, which no longer exists in Home Assistant's device registry — it may have been removed or re-paired on the Lutron bridge. Its button presses will do nothing until this is resolved. Edit or remove this Pico Link entry to match your current hardware.
